components.title: Postgres adapter public boundary
components.rationale: Exports transactional state, plan, archive, delivery and capability adapters behind stable PostgreSQL boundaries.

components.title: Run state persistence
components.rationale: Persists run events, snapshots and metadata without owning lifecycle rules.

components.title: RunStateCommandPort bridge
components.rationale: Explicit bridge from the DVT run-state command boundary into PostgreSQL write storage.

components.title: Postgres plan store
components.rationale: Stores and queries immutable/admitted plan records and executable plan artifacts.

components.title: Outbox + lineage persistence
components.rationale: PostgreSQL implementations for delivery/outbox facts and lineage outbox storage.

components.title: Run archive persistence
components.rationale: Persistence adapters used by state-store archive/retention lifecycle.

components.title: Backpressure snapshot reader
components.rationale: Reads bounded delivery-pressure snapshots used by admission policies.

components.title: Object-file to Postgres capability
components.rationale: Provider-specific object-file materialization capability exposed to runtime plugins.

components.title: Schema + runtime composition
components.rationale: Owns PostgreSQL schema migration/runtime configuration mechanics, not domain semantics.

components.title: Credentials + pool policy
components.rationale: Infrastructure-level credential binding and observed pool failure policy.
